items.title: Pakistan registers $3.6bn in remittances for July 2026
items.summary:
The inflow of overseas workers’ remittances into Pakistan stood at $3.631 billion in July 2026, the State Bank of Pakistan (SBP) data showed on Monday.
In terms of growth, remittances increased by 4.5% on a month-on-month basis and 13% on a year-on-year basis.
